create.name: Sri Dharma Mittra
create.bio:
Sri Dharma Mittra was born in 1939 in Minas Gerais, Brazil, and first came to yoga through books in his teens, after years as an air force serviceman, bodybuilder and wrestler. In 1964 he travelled to New York to study with his guru, Swami Kailashananda, also known as Yogi Gupta, and gave roughly ten years to full-time training and service, taking the vows of a renunciate along the way. In 1975 he opened his own school in Manhattan, among the first independent yoga schools in the city, which carries on today as the Dharma Yoga Center on West 24th Street. He is known for the Master Yoga Chart of 908 Postures, for which he photographed himself in every pose, and for the book Asanas: 608 Yoga Poses.

His method, Dharma Yoga, treats postures as one part of the classical eight limbs. Strong and often advanced asana sits alongside breathing practice, deep relaxation, meditation and plain talks on ethics, compassion towards all beings and the search for self-knowledge. Now in his eighties, he still teaches classes in New York, in person and over Zoom, leads the Life of a Yogi teacher trainings with his senior students, offers recorded classes online, and travels for occasional weekends, including an advanced immersion at Kripalu.

books.title: Asanas: 608 Yoga Poses
books.author: Dharma Mittra
books.description: A large photographic reference drawn from the poster on which Dharma Mittra pictured himself in 908 postures. Each of the 608 photographs is labelled with the English and Sanskrit name of the pose, with short notes and suggested combinations for different styles of practice.

courses.title: Dharma Yoga Immersion Weekend: Yogic Wisdom for Advanced Practitioners
courses.description: A residential weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, taught by Sri Dharma himself. Sessions combine Dharma Yoga postures, breathing practice, guided meditation and Vedantic philosophy, and are aimed at experienced students.

courses.title: Classes with Sri Dharma Mittra at the Dharma Yoga Center
courses.description: Regular group classes at the Dharma Yoga Center in Manhattan, several of them led by Sri Dharma, which can also be joined live over Zoom. Single classes and passes are booked through the centre's schedule or app.

courses.title: Maha Sadhana Workshop
courses.description: A three-hour workshop built around Sri Dharma's Maha Sadhana, a long classical sequence that takes in postures, breathwork, relaxation and a spiritual talk. It runs at the New York centre and on Zoom; new dates are announced on the events page.
courses.price: $39 USD in person, $30 USD on Zoom

courses.title: Dharma Yoga Online
courses.description: The school's on-demand library of classes and workshops with Sri Dharma, including a masterclass series and a short film about the making of his 908-posture chart. It can be streamed on a phone, computer or television.

courses.title: Dharma Yoga Life of a Yogi 50-Hour Teacher Training (On Demand)
courses.description: A recorded version of the entry-level Life of a Yogi training, which breaks down Sri Dharma's all-levels warm-up series and includes full classes, lectures and a closing satsang. Access lasts twelve months.

courses.title: Dharma Yoga Life of a Yogi 200-Hour Teacher Training
courses.description: An eleven-day foundation training in the Dharma Yoga method, taught by Sri Dharma and his senior teachers in New York and streamed live on Zoom, with recordings kept for a year. The focus is on practising and learning to teach the Sukha and Dharma Sadhana A class series.
courses.price: $3,995 USD tuition plus $150 USD application fee

courses.title: Dharma Yoga Life of a Yogi 500-Hour Teacher Training
courses.description: An advanced training for certified teachers in two week-long modules, exploring the wider science of yoga through Sri Dharma's own experience with his guru. Students work on the Dharma II and III series and how to share them, in person or on Zoom.
courses.price: $4,995 USD tuition plus $150 USD application fee
